macros.name: auxlinedistance
macros.doc: To allow the user to use other dimensions than mm the macro \auxlinedistance is used.

macros.name: extratopmargin
macros.doc: With a positive \extratopmargin the labels will be shifted down (negative values are allowed).

macros.name: fullheight
macros.doc: To switch to large labels use the macro \fullheight.

macros.name: labeltextmargin
macros.doc: The distance between the text box of \labeltext and the label border is controlled by the length \labeltextmargin.

macros.name: narrowlabels
macros.doc: To switch to narrow labels use the macro \narrowlabels.

macros.name: widelabels
macros.doc: To switch to wide labels use the macro \widelabels.
